Bailey's North Jubbal or Barari lexical section maps to canonical Barari and is distinct from the Koci chapters\. The LSI IX\(IV\) account of Barari on pp\. 599–601 has a prose specimen, not this vocabulary\. Zoller 2023 Barari citations to Bailey p\. 185 are derivative attestations of the same printed evidence, not independent field elicitation\.
